title: Spanish Paella with Charred Cabbage
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, featuring charred cabbage and tender flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo sausage and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic, paella seasoning, and saffron, and stir to combine.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Add the charred cabbage and stir to combine.
Simmer for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
